How does autonomous-draft keep Rule 1 (no frozen CONTRACT → no squads)?

CONTRACT frozen as `v1.0-draft` for the squads; PLAN-REVIEW (G4) records your G2 answers and G3 approval in one stop; `freeze` bumps to v1.0; a contradiction that changes the CONTRACT re-enters squads as an amendment
Review before squads write (the praxya order)
Your stated behaviour is "entire plan end-to-end, then contradict"; the draft is frozen for the squads so they cannot drift from each other; the amendment loop already exists
Where does an "Owner decision, not a build" triage verdict go?
to `CLOSED_WITHOUT_PLAN` with a decision memo and a reopen condition
back into anamnesis if you rule in the same sitting

headers: Why nobody should pick for you
rows: May the squads commit to `epic/v4*` branches and the orchestrator merge to `main` overnight without a per-merge ping?
merging to `main` of a published plugin is your repository's history; it can be reverted but not un-happened
May the orchestrator tag and push the `4.0.0` release and update the marketplace entry once the Definition of SHIPPED is green?
[DECIDED] HELD until O-2 — the orchestrator does not tag
a published version reaches every installer; reverting a marketplace version is visible to users
May the QA session open Chrome on this Mac to look at rendered twins (`--open` at gates), and run headless fallback sessions if a terminal sticks?
it drives your browser and spawns processes on your machine
May the orchestrator commit the guard mirror fix applied during planning (one-file copy, uncommitted now) as its first W0 commit?
it is the first code change of 4.0.0 landing on `main`
